db_type.description: Database backend. PuppetDB supports only PostgreSQL.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

db_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use.

db_user.description: Database user account PuppetDB will connect as.

db_password.description: Password for the database user. Leave empty if using peer auth or SSL certs.

db_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to PostgreSQL.

db_ssl_cert.description: Path to client certificate for PostgreSQL SSL authentication.

db_ssl_key.description: Path to client private key for PostgreSQL SSL authentication.

db_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate used to verify the PostgreSQL server.

http_host.description: Interface to bind the HTTP endpoint to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces (not recommended in production without TLS).

https_host.description: Interface to bind the HTTPS endpoint to.

https_ssl_key.description: Path to private key for HTTPS. Must be world-readable if owned by root.

https_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate for HTTPS.

https_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA cert used to verify client certificates (optional).

request_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a request (e.g., '30s', '5m').

max_connection_pool_size.description: Maximum number of database connections in the pool.

log_level.description: Verbosity of PuppetDB logging. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

ha_enabled.description: Enable high-availability mode (requires external database HA & load balancer).

query_workers.description: Number of threads used to process queries concurrently.

query_max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of queued queries before rejecting.

node_purge_ttl.description: Time after which inactive nodes are purged from the database.

java_args.description: Java arguments passed to PuppetDB JVM (e.g., memory limits, GC options, JMX settings).
